definitions.full: H7871. shibah I. [ שִׁיבָה ] noun feminine sojourn (= ֗֗֗ יְשִׁיבָה according to Thes) — only בְּשִׁיבָתוֺ 2 Samuel 19:83 during his sojourn ; but read בְּשִׁבָתּוֺ see יָשַׁב Qal 2. — II. שִׁיבָךְ see below שׁוב .
